title: Order status updates are kept in memory
steps: As the owner, update the order from R3.8, e.g. "Mark <customer>'s order as ready."
Check the order in memory (or ask "What's the status of <customer>'s order?").
expected: The order's status updates, its earlier status is kept in its history, and the total price is still correct.
notes: Memory note on the Journey 4 slide: each order keeps its history; status and total price can be updated.
